CUSTOMERIO_SITE_ID.description: Half of the basic auth pair the Track API takes. Despite the name this is not a public site identifier.

CUSTOMERIO_API_KEY.description: The other half of that pair.

CUSTOMERIO_APP_API_TOKEN.description: For the App API, which is bearer rather than basic and carries its own scopes.

CUSTOMERIO_WRITE_KEY.description: The CDP key. Customer.io's browser and server SDKs take the same value, and it says nothing about publishing it, so it stays secret: putting it in a bundle exposes the credential the server uses too.
